title: Factory author report
description: Final report of an isolated author run (clients.py run). The launcher validates it and renders it to the Markdown report its consumers read. API-safe structured-output subset: no length or count limits; the rendered report is truncated at 7900 bytes. Every property is required; an empty list means none.

summary.description: What changed and why, or why there is no patch.

verification.description: Every check that was run or that could not run, with its actual result.

evidence.description: The relevant output, or why it did not run.

acceptance.description: The status of each acceptance criterion of the work order.

criterion.description: The criterion ID, for example AC-1.

review_items.description: One response per review finding or problem to fix; empty for a first implementation.

explanation.description: The fix, the evidence for the dispute, or the missing prerequisite.

control_proposals.description: Proposed changes to read-only control paths, for a maintainer to apply by hand.

open_issues.description: Remaining risks, blockers and unverified points.
